name: Amazon Shipping India
source: Public JSON from track.amazon.in, recorded 2026-10-29 for a delivered shipment; see tests/fixtures/amazon_shipping.json. Statuses other than the seven seen (CreationConfirmed, PickupDone, Received, Departed, OutForDelivery, DeliveryAttempted, Delivered) are unmapped and read as Exception. Event times carry no timezone; Indian Standard Time is an assumption from the Indian locations.
